column1: # Source repos to copy skills from. The daily sync rebuilds skills/ from this list.
# Columns (tab or spaces): repo  from  to
#   repo  GitHub owner/name, default branch is used
#   from  folder in that repo whose subfolders are skills (. = repo root)
#   to    *          copy each skill as its own skill
#         name/sub   bundle all skills under skills/name/sub, with a generated
#                    skills/name/SKILL.md that tells Claude which one to read
